name: real-world-data
description: A benchmark of real-world contact-aware sensor data intended to evaluate models and systems that detect and reason about physical contact during manipulation. It measures robustness and accuracy of contact/event detection, force estimation, and multimodal perception (e.g., tactile + visual) on production-like data. Designed to stress algorithms with noisy, real-world signals rather than clean simulation data.
reputation: Niche dataset used in contact-aware robotics research with limited but growing adoption.
